modeling_decisions: Concept personally inspected. Retain continuous vertical dark dike interrupting warm horizontal host layers at front/rear exposed sections and irregular crest above terrain. Reject masonry-like regularly stacked little blocks: one coherent continuous tabular solid with bounded rough side relief and irregular top profile. Terrain host height3m, dike crest6.5–9m total; intrusionXcenter0.1*sin(y*.3), width0.9m, traversesY-12to12. Host beds at0–1,1–2,2–3m split left/right at actual intrusion faces. No decorative freestanding wall or parallel-to-bedding sill, floating rubble or tiny textures.
